quotes.t: All beings are by nature are Buddhas, as ice by nature is water. Apart from water there is no ice; apart from beings, no Buddhas. How sad that people ignore the near and search the truth afar: like someone in the midst of water crying out in thirst: like a child of a wealthy home wandering among the poor.
quotes.c: As quoted in Teachings of the Buddha p. 207

quotes.t: If you forget yourself, you become the universe.
quotes.c: As quoted in The Awakening Artist: Madness and Spiritual Awakening in Art by Patrick Howe

quotes.t: Should you desire the great tranquility prepare to sweat white beads.
quotes.c: As quoted in Zen and the Art of Poker: Timeless Secrets to Transform Your Game by Larry W. Phillips

quotes.t: You know the sound of two hands clapping; tell me, what is the sound of one hand?
quotes.c: As quoted in Wild Ivy: The Spiritual Autobiography of Zen Master Hakuin trans. Norman Waddell (2010) p. 179
